mapper.sql: LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT CONCAT('kp:',k.kp_id) AS topic_key,k.name AS topic FROM paper_question_knowledge k WHERE k.paper_question_id=pq.id UNION ALL SELECT CONCAT('legacy:',p.subject_id,':',TRIM(label)),TRIM(label) FROM regexp_split_to_table(COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(pq.knowledge_point),''),'综合巩固'),'[,，;；|]') label WHERE TRIM(label)!='' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM paper_question_knowledge k WHERE k.paper_question_id=pq.id) ) tags ON TRUE
mapper.select:
SELECT tags.topic_key,tags.topic,s.subject_name,COUNT(DISTINCT pq.id) AS total FROM paper_question pq JOIN paper p ON p.id=pq.paper_id JOIN subject s ON s.id=p.subject_id JOIN exam e ON e.paper_id=pq.paper_id JOIN exam_student es ON es.exam_id=e.id
WHERE es.student_id=#{userId} AND es.status=3 AND e.release_status=2 AND e.end_time<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP GROUP BY tags.topic_key,tags.topic,s.subject_name ORDER BY s.subject_name,tags.topic

SELECT DISTINCT ON (pq.id) pq.id,pq.content,pq.options,pq.type,pq.answer,pq.analysis,pq.knowledge_point,e.exam_name FROM paper_question pq JOIN paper p ON p.id=pq.paper_id JOIN exam e ON e.paper_id=pq.paper_id JOIN exam_student es ON es.exam_id=e.id JOIN exam_answer ea ON ea.exam_student_id=es.id AND ea.paper_question_id=pq.id
WHERE es.student_id=#{userId} AND es.status=3 AND e.release_status=2 AND e.end_time<=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (tags.topic_key=#{topic} OR tags.topic=#{topic}) AND ea.marked=1 AND (ea.correct=0 OR ea.score<pq.score) ORDER BY pq.id,e.end_time DESC,e.id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT id,content,options,type,knowledge_point,source_name,actual_answer,correct,answered_at,standard_answer,analysis FROM practice_item WHERE session_id=#{id} ORDER BY snapshot_id,id
SELECT * FROM practice_item WHERE id=#{id} AND session_id=#{sessionId}

SELECT i.knowledge_point,i.correct,i.answered_at,s.id AS session_id,s.topic FROM practice_item i JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE s.user_id=#{userId} AND i.answered_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY i.answered_at DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT id FROM practice_session WHERE id=#{id} AND user_id=#{userId} FOR UPDATE
